name: Flux
description: Issues from a Flux tracker: agents read and update them with swarm flux, a thread attached to an issue keeps it current, and each thread's Flux panel attaches one. Ported from bb's Flux plugin.

settings.title: Flux URL
settings.description: The address you open Flux at. Flux's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: API token
settings.description: From Flux: Settings, API tokens. Flux's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: More Fluxes
settings.description: Other Fluxes, kept by Flux's page of Settings. A JSON list of id, url and token.

commands.name: status
commands.description: The Flux connection, workspace, and signed-in account

commands.name: list
commands.description: Issues, open ones first, grouped by status

commands.name: show
commands.description: An issue with its description, sub-issues, and comments

commands.name: comment
commands.description: Comment on an issue in Markdown

commands.name: start
commands.description: Attach this thread to an issue and move it to In Progress

commands.name: detach
commands.description: Detach this thread from an issue

commands.name: projects
commands.description: Flux projects and the Swarm projects they're linked to

commands.name: link
commands.description: Link a Flux project to this thread's Swarm project

commands.name: open
commands.description: Print an issue's link in Flux

tools.name: issue_images
tools.title: A Flux issue's images
tools.description: Look at the images in a Flux issue's description and comments, which `swarm flux show` writes as [Image N]. Flux shows them only to its members, so their links can't be opened any other way.

images.description: Which images, by their N in [Image N]. Defaults to the first 5.
